thread:
carmen: Hey team — GA for the Sparkline Streaming Connector is live in Hosted now :tada: This provides async streaming + first-class tool-calling over a new endpoint (/v2/stream-connect). Rolling to all regions over the next 48h. Please read the migration notes below before switching traffic.

ashwin: Nice! Does this replace the legacy /v1/stream endpoint or is it opt-in?

carmen: It's opt-in for now. /v1/stream will be supported for 90 days to give folks time to migrate. We strongly recommend moving to /v2/stream-connect because: 1) tool-calling is more robust (structured tool frames), 2) improved KV/cache reuse for multi-turn, 3) per-route cost breakdowns in Console. Docs: https://intranet.redwood.dev/infra/sparkline-streaming (internal).

ashwin: Will SDKs be updated or is this just an endpoint change?

carmen: JS & Python SDKs published today. Packages: `@redwood/sparkline-stream v1.0.0` and `redwood_stream==1.0.0`. They include helpers for tool registration and streaming parsers. Example migration curl: 
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"sparkline-alpha","stream":true,"tools":[{"name":"lookup","url":"https://svc.internal/lookup"}],"input":"Find the latest price for XYZ"}' \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/stream-connect
```
(See SDK helpers for easier wiring).

deploy-bot: deployment sparkline-connectors/hosted -> production succeeded (regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1) :rocket:

sre-oncall: Quick Q — any observed SLO/latency deltas? We need to update runbooks if p95 shifts.

ashwin: Microbenchmarks ran yesterday: p50 token latency +2ms, p95 +6ms at 2048 tokens when tool-calling is active. Overall throughput improved for multi-turn sessions due to better KV reuse. Full perf doc: https://intranet.redwood.dev/perf/sparkline-bench (internal).

maria: Is there a canary key pool for customers to test without hitting production quotas?

carmen: Yes — canary keys are available. If you want early access for a customer, file an internal request here: https://intranet.redwood.dev/ops/canary-keys and tag `@eng-keys`. Canary sessions are rate-limited and flagged in the Console.

security-bot: Heads-up: Sparkline's tool-calling allows server-to-server callbacks. If you enable outbound callbacks from Hosted, you MUST register callback domains in Security Console and enable KMS encryption for any stored credentials. See policy: https://intranet.redwood.dev/security/tool-calling-policy.

eva: Marketing — can we get a one-pager + short blog draft? Want to coordinate external launch timeline and customer emails.

carmen: I'll drop the product brief and draft blog in #docs within 2 hours. Marketing, feel free to reuse the perf numbers and screenshots from Console.

maria: Migration checklist (pinned):
1) Request a canary key (if testing)
2) Update SDK to `@redwood/sparkline-stream v1.0.0` or `redwood_stream==1.0.0`
3) Swap endpoint to `/v2/stream-connect` and register tools via the SDK helper
4) Monitor `tool-call charge` and token breakdown in Console; set alerts for cost regressions
5) If you rely on legacy framing, convert to structured tool frames (see sample mapping in docs)

ashwin: Thanks — we'll start migrating our internal ingestion jobs tomorrow. Any deprecation reminders for customers?

carmen: We'll post a deprecation notice in the Console and email customers using /v1/stream. Official shutdown of /v1/stream is scheduled 90 days from today. We'll provide a migration script and a compatibility shim for common cases.

marketing: Can we include a short 'what to expect' bullet list for customers that are not infra-savvy?

carmen: Yes — I'll include a simplified customer-facing FAQ in the brief.

maria: FYI ops: monitoring now surfaces `sparkline.tool_calls` metric and a new trace span `sparkline.stream.frame` in X-Ray. Update runbooks if you use these for alerts.

deploy-bot: canary deployment sparkline-connectors/canary -> succeeded (canary group: internal-testers) :white_check_mark:

ashwin: One last thing — does the new endpoint affect rate limiting or quotas?

carmen: No quota changes today. We added a new per-route meter for tool-calls so you can see cost attribution; quota enforcement remains consistent with existing rules. If you have high-throughput needs, contact sales for Dedicated reservations.

carmen: Thanks everyone. If you run into problems during migration ping `@sre-oncall` or open a thread in #release-war-room. I'll update this thread with links to the customer FAQ and migration script when ready. :handshake:
